description: Source code for ext2 filesystem formatting in Zephyr OS, including functions for validating configuration, setting up filesystem structures, and creating initial directories and inodes.

methods.name: validate_config
methods.description: Validates and sets default values for ext2 filesystem configuration.

methods.name: set_bitmap_padding
methods.description: Initializes bitmap with padding and set bits.

methods.name: set_bitmap_bits
methods.description: Sets bits in bitmap to indicate used blocks/inodes.

methods.name: default_directory_inode
methods.description: Initializes a directory inode with default values.

methods.name: ext2_format
methods.description: Formats a block device with an ext2 filesystem, creating superblock, group descriptors, bitmaps, inode tables, and initial directories.
